entries.en: What's the plan once we reach the city?
entries.ro: Care-i planul când ajungem în oraș?

entries.en: Well I'm going to see Lizzy Wizzy! I heard she's amazing onstage. Like, supernova.
entries.ro: Păi mă duc s-o văd pe Lizzy Wizzy! Am auzit că arde scena. Ca o supernovă.

entries.en: Wow, who even knew she'd have the energy after all that shit she pulled with those anarchist gangoons.
entries.ro: Wow, de unde energia asta după toate porcăriile alea cu gangsterii ăia anarhiști?

entries.en: What, you mean the Mox? She's got nothing to do with them.
entries.ro: Ce, te referi la Mox? N-are nimic de-a face cu ei.

entries.en: Yeah, suuure. They even named their club after her. I was there, you know.
entries.ro: Da, sigur. Chiar i-au zis clubului după ea. Am fost acolo, știi tu.

entries.en: Yeah, right. If you were really there, you'd know the club's named after some gangoon-killing badass.
entries.ro: Da, sigur. Dacă ai fi fost acolo, ai ști că clubul e pus după un dur care omora gangsteri.

entries.en: Ugh, you sound like such a nomad. Nobody's gonna believe you're from Night City!
entries.ro: Ugh, vorbești ca un nomad. Nimeni n-o să creadă că ești din Night City!
